title: HSK 1.1 · 我们, 没有, 一起, 起来, 别人
focus: 的 · 了 · 我 · 是 · 你 · 有 · 他 · 这 · 我们 · 人 · 一 · 来 · 还 · 没有 · 那 · 他们 · 没 · 里 · 出 · 你们 · 这些 · 还有 · 还是 · 一起 · 起来 · 起 · 一些 · 这里 · 别 · 回 · 一样 · 出来 · 那些 · 女人 · 有些 · 别人 · 们 · 回来 · 别的
body:
The very first building blocks: pronouns (我 你 他), "to have" (有, 没有), "this/that" (这, 那) and direction words with 来 and 出. A handful of characters (一, 这, 那, 还, 起, 别, 回) build most of the two-character words here.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 一 | yī | one | 一起, 一些, 一样 |
| 这 | zhè | this (辶 + 文) | 这些, 这里 |
| 那 | nà | that | 那些 |
| 有 | yǒu | to have (hand over 月 meat) | 没有, 还有, 有些 |
| 还 | hái | still, also | 还有, 还是 |
| 起 | qǐ | rise (走 + 己 jǐ) | 一起, 起来 |
| 别 | bié | other; don't | 别人, 别的 |
| 们 | men | plural marker (亻 + 门 mén) | 我们, 你们, 他们 |

## Watch out

- 人 (person) vs 入 (rù, enter): mirror images.
- 起 ends in 己 jǐ, not 已 yǐ.
- 还 is hái (still) in this lesson, huán when it means "give back".
- 一 changes tone in speech: yìqǐ, yíyàng, yìxiē. The cards show the spoken tones.

cards.Example: 这是我的。 zhè shì wǒ de: This is mine.
cards.Notes: 白 + 勺 sháo; the most common character in Chinese

cards.Meaning: particle: something is done or has changed
cards.Example: 他大了。 tā dà le: He's grown up.
cards.Notes: Lookalike: 子 (zǐ, child) has a line across the middle; 了 does not

cards.Example: 我是学生。 wǒ shì xuésheng: I'm a student.
cards.Notes: Contains 戈 (halberd); originally a pronged weapon, borrowed to mean 'I'. 我 vs 找 (zhǎo, look for)

cards.Example: 是我。 shì wǒ: It's me.
cards.Notes: 日 sun on top + a form of 正 (straight, correct) below: 'correct' became 'to be'

cards.Example: 你好吗? nǐ hǎo ma: How are you?
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 尔 (an old word for 'you')

cards.Example: 我有一个哥哥。 wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge: I have an older brother.
cards.Notes: A hand (𠂇) holding 月 (here: meat): holding meat = to have

cards.Example: 他是我哥哥。 tā shì wǒ gēge: He's my older brother.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 也; same sound as 她 (女 woman) and 它 (it)

cards.Example: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme: What's this?
cards.Notes: 辶 movement radical + 文; colloquially also zhèi

cards.Example: 我们都在。 wǒmen dōu zài: We're all here.
cards.Notes: 们 = 亻 person + 门 mén for the sound; it makes pronouns plural

cards.Example: 他是好人。 tā shì hǎo rén: He's a good person.
cards.Notes: Picture of a person walking. 人 vs 入 (rù, enter) vs 八 (bā, eight)

cards.Example: 我要一个。 wǒ yào yí ge: I want one.
cards.Notes: One stroke = one. Tone shifts in speech: yí before 4th tone, yì before others

cards.Example: 他来了! tā lái le: He's here!
cards.Notes: 来 vs 米 (mǐ, rice): 来 has an extra line on top

cards.Example: 你还在吗? nǐ hái zài ma: Are you still there?
cards.Notes: 辶 movement + 不; hái = still, huán = return something (还书 return a book)

cards.Example: 我没有钱。 wǒ méiyǒu qián: I don't have money.
cards.Notes: 没 not + 有 have = not have; before a verb it negates the past: 没有去 didn't go

cards.Example: 那是谁? nà shì shéi: Who's that?
cards.Notes: 阝 on the right (town radical); colloquially nèi. 那 (that) vs 哪 (nǎ, which), which adds 口

cards.Example: 他们不在。 tāmen bú zài: They're not here.
cards.Notes: 他 has 亻 (person) on the left; compare 她 with 女 (woman)

cards.Example: 我没去。 wǒ méi qù: I didn't go.
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 殳-like right side; originally 'sink, submerge' (mò), now the everyday 'not have'

cards.Example: 钱在包里。 qián zài bāo li: The money's in the bag.
cards.Notes: 田 field + 土 earth (village); also stands for 'inside' (traditional 裡)

cards.Example: 他出门了。 tā chū mén le: He went out.
cards.Notes: Looks like two 山 stacked; old form was a foot stepping out of a pit

cards.Example: 你们好! nǐmen hǎo: Hi, everyone!
cards.Notes: 你 you + 们 plural marker (亻 + 门 mén for the sound)

cards.Example: 这些是你的吗? zhèxiē shì nǐ de ma: Are these yours?
cards.Notes: 这 this + 些 some, a few = these

cards.Example: 还有一个。 hái yǒu yí ge: There's one more.
cards.Notes: 还 still + 有 have = there's still more; also 'and also' in lists

cards.Example: 茶还是咖啡? chá háishi kāfēi: Tea or coffee?
cards.Notes: 还 still + 是 be; in questions it means 'or'; 我们还是走吧 = we'd better go

cards.Example: 我们一起去吧。 wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba: Let's go together.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 起 rise, start = starting as one: together

cards.Meaning: to get up; (after verb) start to
cards.Example: 快起来! kuài qǐlai: Get up, quick!
cards.Notes: 起 rise + 来 come = come up; after verbs it means 'begin': 笑起来 burst out laughing

cards.Meaning: to rise, get up; to start
cards.Example: 他起得很早。 tā qǐ de hěn zǎo: He gets up early.
cards.Notes: 走 walk radical + 己 jǐ for the sound. 己 vs 已 (yǐ) vs 巳 (sì)

cards.Example: 我买了一些水果。 wǒ mǎi le yìxiē shuǐguǒ: I bought some fruit.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 些 some = a little bit; 些 = 此 cǐ (this) + 二

cards.Example: 这里很好。 zhèlǐ hěn hǎo: It's nice here.
cards.Notes: 这 this + 里 inside = in this place; also said 这儿 zhèr

cards.Example: 别走! bié zǒu: Don't go!
cards.Notes: 刂 knife on the right: cut apart, separate, so 'other' and 'don't'

cards.Example: 我回来了。 wǒ huílai le: I'm back.
cards.Notes: A small box inside a big box, like going round and back again

cards.Example: 我们一样高。 wǒmen yíyàng gāo: We're the same height.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 样 appearance (木 + 羊 yáng for the sound) = one look: the same

cards.Example: 你出来一下。 nǐ chūlai yíxià: Come out for a sec.
cards.Notes: 出 out + 来 come (toward the speaker); after verbs: 想出来 think up

cards.Example: 那些是谁的? nàxiē shì shéi de: Whose are those?
cards.Notes: 那 that + 些 some = those; mirror of 这些

cards.Example: 那个女人是谁? nàge nǚrén shì shéi: Who's that woman?
cards.Notes: 女 woman (a kneeling figure) + 人 person

cards.Example: 有些人不喜欢。 yǒuxiē rén bù xǐhuan: Some people don't like it.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 些 some = there are some; before adjectives: 有些累 a bit tired

cards.Example: 别人都走了。 biérén dōu zǒu le: Everyone else left.
cards.Notes: 别 other + 人 person = others

cards.Example: 同学们好! tóngxuémen hǎo: Hello, class!
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 门 mén for the sound; neutral tone

cards.Example: 你什么时候回来? nǐ shénme shíhou huílai: When are you coming back?
cards.Notes: 回 return + 来 come (toward the speaker) = come back

cards.Example: 你要别的吗? nǐ yào biéde ma: Want anything else?
cards.Notes: 别 other + 的 (makes a noun phrase) = other ones
